_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4). Based on games-steamcmd avorion/egg-avorion.json (pelican-eggs, MIT licence). Octail adds automatic query, Steam query and Steam master ports instead of fixed defaults, makes the admin optional (a Steam64 ID when set), quotes the galaxy name and limits it to safe characters, fixes the int rules (integer), and adds the avorion tag, the /say broadcast, the Steam query (A2S) for player counts, install sandbox defaults and resource hints. **Install script fixed**: server.ini from raw.githubusercontent.com at the pinned games-steamcmd commit and only when the galaxy has none (upstream overwrote it on every reinstall), and the install fails when SteamCMD didn't download the server. SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times: its first run on a fresh install often fails with "Missing configuration".
name: Avorion
author: iamkubi@gmail.com
description: A procedural co-op space sandbox where players can build their own space ships out of dynamically scalable blocks. Fight epic space battles, explore, mine, trade, wage wars and build your own empire to save your galaxy from being torn apart by an unknown enemy.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Avorion Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server


## just in case someone removed the defaults.
if [[ "${STEAM_USER}" == "" ]] || [[ "${STEAM_PASS}" == "" ]]; then
    echo -e "steam user is not set.\n"
    echo -e "Using anonymous user.\n"
    STEAM_USER=anonymous
    STEAM_PASS=""
    STEAM_AUTH=""
else
    echo -e "user set to ${STEAM_USER}"
fi

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install game using steamcmd
## Octail: SteamCMD's first run often fails with "Missing configuration"; try up to 3 times
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} $( [[ "${WINDOWS_INSTALL}" == "1" ]] && printf %s '+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows' ) +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAPASS} ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ) ${INSTALL_FLAGS} validate +quit; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so


## Octail: fail the install when SteamCMD didn't download the server
if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/bin/AvorionServer" ]]; then
    echo -e "\nSteamCMD failed to install the Avorion dedicated server; try reinstalling."
    exit 1
fi

mkdir -p /mnt/server/backups
mkdir -p "/mnt/server/galaxy/${GALAXY_NAME}"
## Octail: keep the galaxy's settings on a reinstall; the template comes from the pinned upstream commit
if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/galaxy/${GALAXY_NAME}/server.ini" ]]; then
    curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pelican-eggs/games-steamcmd/8dd208975977aa24a6c53008a65a630c150806b8/avorion/server.ini --output "/mnt/server/galaxy/${GALAXY_NAME}/server.ini"
fi

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Galaxy Name
variables.description: Name of the galaxy (its folder under galaxy/). Letters, digits, spaces, dots, dashes and underscores.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The name of the server, shown in the server list.

variables.name: Admin ID
variables.description: Optional: the Steam64 ID (17 digits) of the player to make server admin.

variables.name: Game Difficulty
variables.description: Difficulty of the server, allowed values are: -3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3 Default: 0

variables.name: Collision Damage
variables.description: A multiplier for damage to colliding objects. Accepts floating-point numbers, e.g. 0.5 is 50% collision damage. 0: no damage, 1: full damage. default: 1

variables.name: Save Interval
variables.description: Time between automatic saves in seconds.  Defaults to 300 (5 minutes).

variables.name: Same Start Sector
variables.description: Indicates if all players should start in the same sector. If false, a random empty sector on the outer rim is populated and used as the home sector for each new player.

variables.name: Threads
variables.description: Number of concurrent threads that are used to update sectors. (Identical to the 'Threads' setting ingame.)

variables.name: List Publicly
variables.description: Privacy setting. If enabled together with useSteam, the server will show up in public server lists. (Same as the ingame setting 'List Publicly')

variables.name: Steam Master Port
variables.description: Steam master server port (--steam-master-port). Set by Octail when the server is created (three after the game port).

variables.name: Steam Query Port
variables.description: Steam query port (--steam-query-port). Set by Octail when the server is created (two after the game port).

variables.name: Query Port
variables.description: Avorion's own query port (--query-port). Set by Octail when the server is created (the port after the game port).

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: Leave empty for the public branch, beta for the beta branch.
